Container.Name: KindRobots
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Kind Robots Nuxt/Nitro application. The image is built locally from /mnt/user/appdata/kind_robots, while the container reads the existing repo .env at runtime. Common deployment settings stay editable in the Unraid Docker WebGUI without duplicating the full secret environment.
Container.Requires: Build the local image first from /mnt/user/appdata/kind_robots with `docker build -t kind-robots:local .`. Keep the mounted .env private. Publish through an HTTPS reverse proxy; do not expose the application port directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Kind Robots HTTP server. Point the HTTPS reverse proxy at this port.

Config.Name: Environment File
Config.Description: Existing Kind Robots .env file. The container loads it at runtime, so the full secret environment does not need to be recreated in DockerMan.

Config.Name: Media Images
Config.Description: Persistent Kind Robots image library. The runtime also exposes /app/public as a symlink to the same built public tree for legacy relative paths.

Config.Name: Public App URL
Config.Description: Canonical public URL used by Kind Robots. Container environment variables override values from the mounted .env file.

Config.Name: Auth Origin
Config.Description: Canonical authentication origin. Container environment variables override values from the mounted .env file.
